name: discipline
description: Session-start operating defaults that cut token spend without cutting task success, tuned for Claude Opus 5 agentic coding. Ships a byte-stable 220-token block for the cached system prefix plus the measured evidence behind every clause, including a paired 106-task benchmark showing that caveman-style response compression cost 7.6 points of task score on Opus 5, with 78% of its apparent saving coming from the agent taking fewer steps rather than writing more tersely.
